user.title: Casora
user.description: Adds the Casora configuration panel to the sidebar.

init.title: Casora – Settings
init.description: Leave fields empty to let Casora choose: the default AI from Settings → AI tasks and outdoor sensors by name.

data.ai_task_entity: AI for coaches, cameras and plants
data.ai_task_web_entity: AI with web search (update check, recipe)
data.rezept_liste: Shopping list for the ingredients (recipe of the week)

data_description.ki_hinweise: Added to every review, e.g. “The bedroom window is tilted on purpose.”
data_description.ki_plan_energie: Automatic: Sundays at 18:00. Custom time e.g. “sun 18:00” (mon to sun).
data_description.ki_plan_heizung: Automatic: Mondays at 07:00, heating season only.
data_description.ki_plan_update: Daily: once a day. Off: no AI assessment in the updates popup.
data_description.lueften_push: “Ventilate now” (7–22 h) and “Close window” (7–23 h) after 10 min, CO₂ above 2500 ppm right away. Empty = no push notifications.
data_description.lueften_personen: “Ventilate now” only when one of these people is home. Empty = anyone.
data_description.update_push: One push per new version to the selected phones. Tapping it opens Casora's updates. Empty = off.
data_description.beta_updates: Try new features earlier. Betas can have bugs. With HACS, turn on betas in HACS instead.

error.invalid_plan: Invalid time. Allowed: Off, Automatic or e.g. “sun 18:00”.

energie_coach.name: Energy coach
energie_coach.description: Reviews last week's energy dashboard data with AI.

heizungs_coach.name: Heating coach
heizungs_coach.description: Reviews last week's heating time and temperatures with AI.

lueftungs_coach.name: Ventilation coach
lueftungs_coach.description: Reviews last week's humidity, CO₂ and window openings with AI.

kamera_beschreiben.name: Describe camera image
kamera_beschreiben.description: Lets the AI describe the current camera image.

pflanzen_doktor.name: Plant doctor
pflanzen_doktor.description: Care tip for a plant from 7 days of readings.

aquarium_doktor.name: Aquarium doctor
aquarium_doktor.description: AI assessment of an aquarium from 7 days of temperature, equipment, light and leak sensor.

devices.name: Equipment
devices.description: List of devices: label, entity, power

ebike_check.name: Bike check
ebike_check.description: AI assessment of the e-bike: service, wear by mileage and battery care.

update_pruefen.name: Check update with AI
update_pruefen.description: Checks release notes of pending updates against this system.

rezept_neu.name: New recipe idea
rezept_neu.description: Lets the AI suggest a recipe of the week.

rezept_auf_liste.name: Ingredients to shopping list
rezept_auf_liste.description: Adds the recipe's ingredients to the shopping list.

umstellen.name: Switch to Casora names
umstellen.description: Converts older dashboards to Casora names (with backup).

einrichten.name: Set up
einrichten.description: Creates missing Casora helpers and scripts (runs automatically at startup) and reports anything it could not create.

restart_after_update.title: Casora {version} installed – restart required
restart_after_update.description: Casora was updated to version {version}. Restart Home Assistant to load it.
